This note has no headings at all. It is a single run of prose, the shape that
break-point splitting exists for, and it is long enough that a low ceiling has
to divide it somewhere.

The first stretch describes the tank. The tank sits above the plots and feeds
the manifold by gravity alone, which is why nothing here needs a pump. Head
pressure is set by the tank height and nothing else.

---

The second stretch describes the zones. Each zone has its own valve and its
own emitter spacing, chosen for the crop rather than for convenience. Zone
three is the odd one out because the ground falls away.

```text
# This heading is inside a fence and is not a heading.
[[Fenced Link Target]] is inside a fence and is not an edge.
```

The third stretch is about maintenance. Emitters clog, unions loosen, and the
filter needs a rinse every fortnight. None of that is interesting until it is
the reason a bed dried out.

The final stretch is a note to self: write this up properly one day, with the
zone map beside it, so the next person does not have to walk the line to learn
what the line does.
